pages.title: Read the Damage
pages.text: The tooltip and real attack use one calculation, listing base damage, stage bonus, resource payment, and tempering bonus in order. Anvils accept the current Netherite Sword enchantment set.

pages.title: Continuous Tempering
pages.text: Place the sword in a Furnace, Blast Furnace, placed Immortal Furnace, or embedded furnace. Each completion adds 1 tempering point, grants no experience, and returns the result to input. A Spirit Sword gains 1% damage per point.

pages.title: The Cost of a Hit
pages.text: After each hit, tempering points halve and round down. Aura repair spends the matching Yuan to restore durability. Insufficient balance does not cancel the attack, but that hit keeps only base weapon damage.

pages.title: Two Forging Paths
pages.text: The Immortal-Ruin-Forged sword raises the coefficient to 1.5% and widens sweeping. The One-Qi sword has 0% melee growth and reserves points for phase-three beams. Both preserve the core progression but create distinct combat rhythms.
